onChange.script:
if currentValue.value["period"].value != "":
		# if value in dropdown changes (but not empties, set start/end time to the bound start and end time)
		self.custom.launchpad.oee.display.customTime.start = system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(system.date.now()),currentValue.value["start"].value)
		self.custom.launchpad.oee.display.customTime.stop = system.date.addSeconds(system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(system.date.now()),currentValue.value["stop"].value),-1)

transforms.code:
# Re-browsed on a timer, not once at session start. A session opened before
	# the tags exist -- which is exactly what happens between importing the
	# project and pressing Set up -- used to hold an empty list for its whole
	# life, and an empty list leaves the line dropdown with nothing to select,
	# every live value null and a quality overlay over the card.
	return launchpad.oee.getLineNames(launchpad.oee.BASE_TAG_FOLDER)

onChange.script:
# Only on the empty -> populated transition. That is the recovery case:
	# the session started before the tags existed, so nothing could be
	# selected, and without this the page stays null after the tags arrive.
	# Restricting it to the transition is what keeps <All Lines> working on
	# the Production Summary -- that deliberately selects "", and this must
	# not undo it.
	def names(qv):
		return [str(getattr(v, "value", v)) for v in (qv.value or [])] if qv else []
	now = names(currentValue)
	if now and not names(previousValue):
		if self.custom.launchpad.oee.selectedLine not in now:
			self.custom.launchpad.oee.selectedLine = now[0]

if currentValue.value["period"].value != "":
		# if value in dropdown changes (but not empties, set start/end time to the bound start and end time)
		self.custom.launchpad.oee.report.customTime.start = system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(system.date.now()),currentValue.value["start"].value)
		self.custom.launchpad.oee.report.customTime.stop = system.date.addSeconds(system.date.addDays(system.date.midnight(system.date.now()),currentValue.value["stop"].value),-1)
